basic_info.description: Welcome to 34 Steiner Street, a stunning remodeled flat in the vibrant Duboce Park area. Updated to the studs and seismically enhanced in 2021, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom home offers a unique blend of contemporary style and classic charm. The light-filled corner unit features park views and a private entrance, providing a welcoming retreat. Step inside to discover wide plank floors that connect the open-plan living and dining areas, perfect for entertaining and day-to-day activities. The state-of-the-art kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring a Thermador built-in fridge, induction cooktop, and microwave drawer, complemented by designer finishes.   All three bedrooms are designed for relaxation, with the primary suite boasting a luxurious en suite bath complete with a dual vanity. Stylish bathrooms throughout the home feature Porcelanosa tile, custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, and LED vanity mirrors, adding a touch of sophistication to your daily routine. Enjoy smart home features such as radiant underfloor heating controlled by an Ecobee thermostat and recessed LED lights throught your home. An in-unit hybrid W/D has been added for your convenience. Residents can unwind on the shared roof deck, offering breathtaking 360-degree panoramic views of San Francisco.
